messages:
customer_jdoe: Hey team — after the update this morning our assistant started dropping the initial system instructions for long flows. Example: we send a 12k-token instruction + 6k tokens of conversation and the model ignores the system role and starts answering casually. Not just tone — it literally omits required steps. Repro included below.

jessica_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact request you used and the model name + deployment id? Also are you using streaming?

customer_jdoe: Non-streaming, model: rwd-v1.3 (deployed 2026-03-15T07:12Z), deployment id: prod-rwd-v1-42. Body trimmed for privacy but here's the important bits:
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-v1.3",
  "deployment_id": "prod-rwd-v1-42",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a strict process enforcer. Always reply with numbered steps and verify user compliance."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Long form prompt... ~12k tokens of setup and context"},
    {"role":"user","content":"Now do X following those rules"}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
Response we got started with: "Sure, here's a friendly summary..." — no numbering, skipped verification. Happened immediately after your 07:12 deploy. We also saw the prompt length in logs drop: original prompt bytes 98,432 -> served prompt bytes 21,128 (looks like large truncation).

mike_ml: Thanks for the details. @jessica_support can you paste the full raw request_id/trace id from headers for us to look up the trace? Also did you see any 4xx/5xx or latency spikes in that window?

jessica_support: request-id: req_20260315_18832, trace-id: trace-prod-7f2a. No 5xx in customer logs but the call latency jumped to ~1.6s (normally ~200-350ms). We also saw an auth token refresh for that user around the same time (customer uses short-lived client tokens).

rajesh_eng: Adding context from runtime: the 07:12 deploy introduced the new context-serialization optimization (concatenate/compact historical messages before tokenization). It was intended to be a no-op externally. On quick grep we see a code path that uses byte_count heuristics and will drop older messages when compacted size > 64k bytes. That seems suspicious given customer's 98k bytes.

prod-oncall: Rolling back the 07:12 deploy will likely restore behavior. Any objections?

mike_ml: Before rollback can we confirm whether it's tokenization mismatch vs deliberate eviction? Two possible failure modes: (A) the serializer trimmed earlier than expected, dropping the system role; (B) tokenizer mismatch during model conversion caused different token counts resulting in incorrect kv-cache offsets leading to silent truncation.

jessica_support: Customer is ok with temporary rollback if it speeds the fix.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback initiated for prod-rwd-v1-42 by prod-oncall at 2026-03-15T07:29Z — status: in_progress.

customer_jdoe: Appreciate it — we can tolerate short rollback window. We do have a reproducible small repro we can share privately (sensitive data removed) if that helps.

rajesh_eng: Repro request included by customer (sanitized) reproduces the drop locally in a staging replica using the new serializer. Quick log snippet from staging runtime:
```
[2026-03-15T07:18:12Z] compact_serializer: original_size=98432, compacted_size=21128, dropped_blocks=3
[2026-03-15T07:18:12Z] tokenization: tokens_before=16748, tokens_after=16750
[2026-03-15T07:18:12Z] kv_cache: attach_offset=21128, model_context_window=32768
```
Notice compacted_size 21,128 used as attach_offset into kv_cache which is smaller than tokens_before mapping -> misalignment. That explains missing system message content even though tokenizer counts didn't change much.

mike_ml: That log smells like an off-by-one or a unit mismatch (bytes vs tokens) in the compacted offset calculation. If the attach_offset is in bytes but runtime expects token offsets, we'd point to wrong KV pointers.

rajesh_eng: Confirmed: serializer returns byte offsets but runtime code expects token offsets in several call sites. The 07:12 change touched that path and didn't validate units end-to-end.

prod-oncall: Rollback status: completed at 2026-03-15T07:32Z. Canary traffic shows restored behavior for the customer's test case.

jessica_support: Customer: can you confirm if behavior is back to normal on your side?

customer_jdoe: Verified — assistant now enforces numbered steps again. Thanks.

mike_ml: Root cause summary for the ticket: context-serializer produced offsets in bytes; runtime expected token offsets. When compacted size > threshold the code path used offsets directly which caused partial prompt attachment and loss of the system role. Secondary effect: slight latency increase due to additional compacting and tokenizer calls in the faulty path.

rajesh_eng: Action items: 1) Hotfix to convert serializer offsets to token units before attaching to KV cache (PR #5482). 2) Add end-to-end unit tests that validate system messages survive compaction with >100kB histories. 3) Add a safety limit that refuses byte-based attach_offset and logs an explicit error instead of silently truncating. 4) Add telemetry to emit prompt sizes and attach_offset unit type so we detect similar regressions quickly.

mike_ml: I've assigned PR review to @rajesh_eng and I'll run a staging canary with a 5% traffic ramp after merge.

deploy-bot: PR #5482 merged by rajesh_eng at 2026-03-15T09:10Z. Build started.

prod-oncall: Staging canary executed at 2026-03-15T09:45Z with 5% traffic -> test repro cases passed. Scheduling prod rollout with 10m canary steps.

jessica_support: Closing the customer's escalation? customer_jdoe: please confirm you'd like the ticket closed or want the postmortem & mitigation steps shared.

customer_jdoe: Please share the postmortem and keep us in the loop for the next upgraded deployment. Thanks for the quick response and rollback — much appreciated. :pray:

mike_ml: We'll publish a short incident note summarizing the root cause and long-term mitigations. TL;DR: "serializer unit mismatch -> context truncation in large histories".

rajesh_eng: Postmortem draft created and link will be posted in #incidents. Also adding a monitoring alert: if compacted_size < original_size but attach_offset < (original_token_count * 0.5) emit P1.

prod-oncall: Prod rollout completed by 2026-03-15T12:05Z using patched serializer and 10m canary steps. No regressions observed in the next 6h.

jessica_support: Marking support thread resolved. If anyone wants the raw repro or logs I'll attach them to the PM ticket.

customer_jdoe: Confirmed resolved. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
